scope: Per-machine quota logging and stacked status bars at 946e4f2. A foreground lane router built at 946e4f2 ran beside the daily router on darwin/arm64 with copies of the crookshanks and work logins (both >7 h from token expiry, capacities 1 and 1). Both accounts verified paid overflow disabled and logged quota windows on startup overage_read. One live POST /v1/messages (claude-sonnet-4-6, max_tokens 16) hit 429 on work, migrated to crookshanks, answered 200, and logged model and response-header quota windows in events.jsonl. claude-router status rendered stacked bars, % here, and the legend at 100 and 80 columns, (% here) in status -v, and compact account lines when piped. Offline gofmt, go vet, and go test -race passed at the same head, and a 2-machine fake-upstream end-to-end simulation verified exact additive attribution across both routers. Unchanged historical scenarios are references and were not rerun.
